text: Code reviews are an important part of software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the software reaches users. This saves time and money, because fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other, discover new techniques, and understand different parts of the project. In addition, regular reviews help maintain team quality. Everyone follows the same standards, and the final product is more reliable. Although code reviews take extra time, they are worth the effort. They make the team stronger and the software better.
